modelProvenance: Revision authored in a Codex session whose active model was anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 (coordinator verified turn_context). No other model wrote this revision.
summary: Replaced the gatehouse/section-reveal candidate with a different mechanism along the critique's retry direction: an exposed input field with interchangeable probes and swappable patch walls, where outcomes are raycast from probe/wall geometry.
changes: Rebuilt build_scene.py: removed gatehouses, lids, shutters, roofs and pennants. Added a two-lane field (EMPTY, VALID), a SIGNED IN landing, a wall track with parking pads, two arcaded patch walls (A: both arches bricked; B: low barrier in EMPTY, open VALID), a ring probe and a toothed key probe with hidden amber failure flags, and a rack for the unused probe.

Rewrote interaction.js: two independent controls (coverage, patch). Results come from a THREE.Raycaster cast along each lane against the active wall; pass/fail compares the stop with the probe's expectation; captions are composed from results.
Controls lock during transitions; Reset settles instantly; reduced motion is one-frame.
Regenerated scene.blend, scene.glb, poster.png and scene.json (new title, description, camera, caption and fallback).

addressedFindings.finding: Sequential playback and uncovering authored answers.
addressedFindings.response: Replaced with Add/Remove existing login test and Swap patch, independent and repeatable in any order. Outcomes derive from raycast intersections with wall geometry; no reveal step remains.

addressedFindings.finding: Cosmetic shutters and roof bulk; tiny key distinctions.
addressedFindings.response: All shutters, lids and roofs removed; both lanes stay exposed. Probes are larger and distinct in shape (ring vs toothed key), and lanes carry fixed EMPTY/VALID engravings. The bounded-coverage caveat is kept in the final both-pass caption and the fallback.

addressedFindings.finding: Unverified lid framing and competing lid tweens.
addressedFindings.response: Lids no longer exist. The runner is serial, and both controls disable until a transition ends, so tweens cannot compete.

remainingLimitations: A physical metaphor for one grading step, not a model of authentication code or agent output. Lanes are input regions, and a single probe stands in for one test case.
Repeated trials, clean fixtures, harness errors, time budgets and held-out tasks from the guide are not illustrated.

Only two input regions exist, so the incompleteness of two checks is stated in the final caption and fallback; it is not shown as a third, unprobed region, because any wall geometry there would assert behaviour the guide does not specify.
Lane labels (EMPTY, VALID, SIGNED IN) and wall letters are engraved; legibility at 420px needs browser confirmation.
Beyond-video value is moderate: two lanes and two patches give four states a video could enumerate. The case rests on reader-chosen combinations and inspectable cause.
recommendationNote: Accept only if browser QA confirms the lane labels, probe shapes and amber flag read at 420px; otherwise omit.
verification: Blender 5 build via /opt/homebrew/bin/blender --background --threads 2 --python build_scene.py; .blend saved, GLB exported, poster rendered from the scene.json camera.

Headless Node harness (vendored three.module.js + GLTFLoader parsing the shipped scene.glb) drove both actions, picks, Reset mid-transition, presses during transitions and REDUCED motion; it confirmed node lookups, end states and captions. No browser, WebGL rendering, 420px framing or keyboard focus was exercised: coordinator browser QA is still required.

Harness states: A+new (pass, valid parked), A+both (valid stopped at the wall, flag visible), B+both (valid reaches the seat, no flag), B+new (same as A+new); pick on a wall swaps the patch; buttons disable mid-run; Reset mid-run restores the initial settled state.
Debug renders of the A-both and B-both end states inspected.
